entities.name: Volrath's Dungeon
entities.description: Prison block in the Evincar's Stronghold with torture cells, shifted to Urborg.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The Evincar of Rath who treated prisoners as raw material for tests.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Volrath's fortress on Rath, later shifted to Urborg on Dominaria.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Pacifist taken to the dungeon and tormented by forced killing of goblins.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Minotaur tormented with a mutagenic ray.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where the Stronghold was shifted.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that shifted the Stronghold to Urborg.

events.summary: Karn and Tahngarth are taken to the dungeon during the assault on Rath and tormented.
events.quote: Karn and Tahngarth were taken to the dungeon

events.summary: Tahngarth is exposed to a mutagenic ray that warps his appearance.
events.quote: Tahngarth was exposed to a mutagenic ray

events.summary: Karn is placed in a room of moggs with a tilting floor, crushing goblins.
events.quote: Karn was placed in a room filled with moggs and a floor that suddenly tilted

events.summary: Gerrard, Crovax, Mirri and Starke rescue Karn and Tahngarth.
events.quote: Karn and Tahngarth were both rescued from the dungeon by Gerrard , Crovax , Mirri and Starke .

events.summary: The dungeon shifts with the Stronghold to Urborg during the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: the dungeon was shifted with the rest of the Stronghold to Urborg on Dominaria

relations.note: He used the dungeon for his prisoners.
relations.quote: Volrath's Dungeon was a room where the Evincar placed his prisoners.
